title: testmyagent task contract (task.json)
description: One task version. The layout and the names follow Harbor's task format (harbor-framework/harbor, src/harbor/models/task/config.py and paths.py, schema_version 1.4, Apache-2.0): a [task] package block, [metadata], [agent] and [verifier] with timeout_sec, [environment] with cpus/memory_mb/allow_internet, and the directories instruction.md, environment/, tests/, solution/. Differences from Harbor, on purpose: JSON instead of TOML; the verifier is a declared argv plus a report format instead of tests/test.sh plus a reward file; tests are split into tests/public (in the agent workspace) and tests/hidden (grading container only); the reference solution is a unified diff instead of solve.sh; editable_paths and protected_paths bound the patch.

task.description: Harbor [task] (PackageInfo): the package identity of the task.

metadata.description: Harbor [metadata]: free-form, not used for grading.

instruction.description: Path of the Markdown instruction that the agent receives (Harbor: instruction.md).

environment.description: Harbor [environment]. `dir` holds the starting repository (the agent workspace root); its meaning does not change. `cpus` and `memory_mb` (Harbor) bound the grading containers. `tools`, `run_egress`, `secrets` and `resources` are the TOOL ENVIRONMENT of the agent run (ADR-11, Inspect AI / Valkyrie vocabulary, see docs/contracts/GLOSSARY.md). They are optional: without them a task gets the default environment (every built-in tool, no MCP server, egress to the model gateway only). The runner is the harness: per run it starts each declared MCP server as a sidecar, and the agent cannot add a server or a tool.

install.description: argv run in the workspace before any test, on the trusted side, with network. Lifecycle scripts never run: the evaluator always adds --ignore-scripts for npm. Default: npm ci.

allow_internet.description: Harbor name. Grading never has network on testmyagent; only false is accepted.

tools.description: Inspect: the tools given to the Solver. The runner writes the harness config (opencode `tools` and `mcp`) from this block only.

builtin.description: Allow-list of the harness built-in tools, in neutral names (opencode names: GLOSSARY.md). Absent = all of them. There is no web tool: the run has no internet.

mcp.description: MCP servers that the runner starts per run as sidecars on the sandbox network, with seeded test state and a temporary token.

run_egress.description: Valkyrie run egress, task side. What the agent sandbox can reach while it runs: `model-gateway` (always) = the per-run model gateway; `mcp` = the MCP sidecars of this task (required when one uses transport http). Nothing else. The runner intersects it with the run profile.

secrets.description: Valkyrie `secrets`: NAMES only, never values. The platform resolves each per run and injects it only into the MCP sidecars that list it (tools.mcp[].secrets), never into the agent sandbox.

resources.description: Valkyrie `resources`: upper limits of the AGENT sandbox for this task. The runner uses the lower of this and the run profile.

public.description: Directory copied into the agent workspace at the same relative path.

hidden.description: Directory mounted at the same relative path in the grading container only, after the patch is frozen.

solution.description: The reference solution, used only by the validation gate.

patch.description: Unified diff (git apply) against environment/, paths relative to the workspace root.

editable_paths.description: Globs (workspace-relative; ** = any depth, * = one path segment). A changed file outside these globs makes the run invalid.

protected_paths.description: Globs that a patch must never touch, even inside editable_paths. Must cover the test directories.

verifier.description: Harbor [verifier]. `cmd` is an argv (no shell) run in the workspace root of a grading container. {tests} is replaced by tests.public or tests.hidden, {report} by the path the report must be written to.

report.description: Format of the report file. vitest-json = the Jest-compatible JSON of vitest --reporter=json.

timeout_sec.description: Wall limit of ONE verifier run (one suite).

est_minutes.description: Estimated agent time shown in the catalog.

relPath.description: A relative path inside the task bundle: no leading /, no .. segment, no backslash.

builtinTool.description: A harness built-in tool (neutral name). search = grep + glob, todo = todowrite + todoread in opencode.

mcpServer.description: One MCP server of the task. Exactly one of `image` (an OCI image: the Itera catalog, or a reviewed custom image) or `command` (an argv run in a runner-provided sidecar image).

name.description: Unique in the task. The harness shows the tools as <name>_<tool>.

transport.description: `http` = streamable HTTP on the sandbox network (needs run_egress mcp); `stdio` = the runner bridges the sidecar's stdio to the harness.

image.description: OCI image reference, pinned by tag or digest.

seed.description: Bundle path of the test state loaded into the server before the agent starts (a file or a directory). Never inside environment.dir.

allowed_tools.description: The tools of this server that the agent may call. The runner hides every other tool.

expose_state_to_scorer.description: true = after the run the runner exports the server's final state to the Scorers (trusted plane). The agent never reads it.

secrets.description: Names from environment.secrets that this sidecar receives.

startup_timeout_sec.description: Wall limit for the server to start and answer list_tools.
